data.title: Orla Infinity
data.about:
Indulge in the unparalleled luxury of Orla Infinity, the latest architectural wonder from Omniyat. Orla Infinity seamlessly integrates resort-style living into everyday life, offering a sanctuary where the sand and sea converge to foster clarity and rejuvenation.

Explore 20 distinguished designed 4-bedroom duplex residences, thoughtfully positioned to maximize indoor-outdoor living and provide breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape and cityscape. Each residence embodies beachfront paradise, boasting a private pool where relaxation knows no bounds.

Situated on the prestigious Palm Jumeirah, Orla Infinity offers panoramic vistas of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai's iconic skyline. Discover a lifestyle of refined luxury living, where exclusivity meets sophistication. Explore Orla Infinity's floor plans and inquire about prices, as these exclusive properties are now available for sale. Embrace the essence of Orla Infinity Dorchester Collection, where beauty, elegance, and exclusive privileges converge to create an unparalleled living experience in Dubai's most coveted location.

characteristics_module.title: Feel Infinite Luxury Living at Orla Infinity
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive Living Experience: With only 20 duplex residences, Orla Infinity, brought to you by Omniyat, offers a rare and personalized living experience.
  • Seamlessly Integrated Spaces: Explore Orla Infinity floor plans positioned and designed, seamlessly integrates indoor and outdoor spaces, providing breathtaking views of  the cityscape.
  • Beachfront Bliss: Immerse yourself in beachfront paradise at Orla Infinity, where each residence features a private pool, perfect for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Visionary Design: Crafted by Foster + Partners, the visionary architecture of Orla Infinity sets a new standard in luxury living.
  • Serviced Residences: Managed by the renowned Dorchester Collection, Orla Infinity ensures an exceptional standard of living, offering exclusive privileges and services.
  • Luxurious Interiors: Designed by YODEZEEN, the interiors of Orla Infinity's duplex residences exude opulence and elegance, providing a truly extraordinary living environment.
  • Enchanting Environment: Experience the artful landscaping by ZED Collective at Orla Infinity, blending intimate gardens and open spaces with sweeping views of the iconic Dubai skyline.

location_tile.title: Your Iconic Home: Orla Infinity at Palm Jumeirah
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the heart of Palm Jumeirah, an exclusive destination seamlessly intertwined with the sea, awaits an unparalleled experience of beauty and luxury. Surrounding this enclave are Dubai's premier dining spots, clubs, and beach resorts, ensuring a world-class lifestyle at your doorstep. With the wonders of Dubai easily accessible, every captivating sight becomes within reach.

Located on a sprawling 16,600 sq.m. beachfront plot at the pinnacle of the Palm's crescent, Omniyat Orla Infinity boasts a prime position offering uninterrupted 270° views. From this vantage point, you'll behold Dubai's stunning skyline harmoniously blending with the turquoise waters of the Arabian Gulf.

  • 10 Minutes – Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 13 Minutes – Dubai Marina
  • 16 Minutes – Ain Dubai
  • 19 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates
  • 20 Minutes – Burj Khalifa
  • 25 Minutes – Dubai International Airport
